task: Preserve omitted optional fields on partial assistant updates by honoring the model_fields_set contract across the master-record mapper and the assistant versioning path.

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Initial scope covered only the master-record mapper; the versioning path was discovered and folded in during code review (CR-001).

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Correctness-sensitive persistence logic: a regression could silently wipe omitted optional fields or spuriously create new versions. Subtle reliance on Pydantic model_fields_set semantics.
technical_risk.mitigation: Follows the pre-existing fields_set pattern already used by _should_update_field; fully reversible; covered by targeted regression tests for both the master-record and versioning paths.

key_reasoning.reason: Three coordinated components across two layers: the AssistantBase mapper helpers plus both versioning services (compare + create_new_version), all applying the same partial-update contract.

Persistence-correctness fix relying on model_fields_set; a defect would silently drop omitted fields or spawn spurious versions. Mitigated by an existing precedent pattern and dedicated regression tests.
6 files changed (3 source + 3 test), all edits to existing files, spanning API-model and service test directories.
